list.title: Cases
list.help: Every enforcement action, newest first. Filter by member, moderator, type, status, tag or date.
list.exportPlan: Case export (CSV) comes with Mewvo Normal and up, on the server owner's plan. {plans}
list.empty: No cases yet. They show up here after the first warn, mute, kick or ban.

bulk.void: Remove them (a mistake, they stop counting)
bulk.reason: Reason (for removing; the members see it)
bulk.help: Tags: up to 25 cases at once. Removing: up to 10, and each member gets the usual DM. Removing shows a confirm page first.

next.oneAfter: The one after it would mean an automatic ban ({ban}).

moreAfter.one: {count} more after it would mean an automatic ban ({ban}).
moreAfter.other: {count} more after it would mean an automatic ban ({ban}).

next.limit: It would reach the warning limit: an automatic ban ({ban}, warning stage {stage} of 3).
next.ladderOff: Warnings are recorded but never lead to an automatic ban in this server (the warn ladder is off).

evidence.imageGone: Image not available (the stored message is gone).

detail.title: Case {code}
detail.name: Name
detail.noNotes: No notes. Only staff can see notes.

uncounted.automod: Automod warning — doesn't count toward bans
uncounted.ladderOff: Warning — doesn't count toward bans (warn ladder off)

appeals.title: Pending appeals ({count})
appeals.help: Appeals waiting for a decision, oldest first. Amber after a day, red after three.
appeals.secondReviewerTitle: You issued this punishment, so another staff member has to decide this appeal.
appeals.decideHere: Decide here or in Discord (Accept / Deny on the appeal message): the effects are the same.
appeals.adminsDecide: Administrators decide appeals here (with editing on) or in Discord.
appeals.empty: No pending appeals. New appeals show up here and in the appeal channels in Discord.
appeals.noChannelTitle: This server has no appeals category, so this appeal has no channel in Discord. Decide it here.

change.title: Change this case
change.removedNoEdit: Removed cases can no longer be edited.
change.durationHint: Total from when it was given, e.g. 7d, 1mo.
change.durationHintBan: Total from when it was given, e.g. 7d, 1mo, permanent.
change.removeHelp: For a case given by mistake: it stops counting. This lifts what is still in effect (unban, unmute, warning removed, warning stage stepped back) and DMs the member the reason. The case stays on record, marked Removed.
change.removeNext: Nothing happens yet: the next page shows what will be lifted, and you confirm there.
change.link: Link (e.g. a Discord message link: its text is saved)
change.image: Image (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 8 MB)
change.rehosted: Images are re-hosted in the evidence channel, as with /case evidence add.
change.staffOnly: Only staff see these. The member never does.
change.tagsHint: Comma-separated. Leave empty to remove all.

appeal.heading: Appeal ·
appeal.title: Appeal {code}
appeal.testNotice: Test case created with /test: nothing was executed, accepting it changes nothing.
appeal.reviewNeeded: Issued by {name}, so it needs a second reviewer
appeal.ownerOverride: You issued this punishment. As a bot owner you may decide anyway; it is logged as an owner override.
appeal.note: Note (optional, shown in the appeal channel and the log)
appeal.noChannel: This appeal has no channel in Discord (the server has no appeals category). Decide it here.

effect.test: Test case: only the record is closed.
effect.ban: The member is unbanned (if still banned), DMed with an invite back, and the case is lifted.
effect.mute: The member is unmuted (if still muted), DMed, and the case is lifted.
effect.warn: The warning is removed (the ladder count drops; an automatic ban it caused is lifted) and the member is DMed.
effect.lifted: The case is lifted and the member is DMed.
effect.deny: The punishment stays. The member is DMed that the appeal was denied.
effect.warnUncounted: The warning is removed and the member is DMed. It never counted toward the warn ladder, so nothing else changes.

appealConfirm.stage3: This stage-3 warning ban can then no longer be appealed.
appealConfirm.channel: The appeal channel gets the decision and is deleted 10 seconds later (its transcript goes to the mod log). This confirmation works once and expires in 5 minutes.
appealConfirm.title: Confirm appeal {code}
